verdict.rationale: Founder Law's pricing page sells flat-fee packages that explicitly include all USCIS government filing fees, premium processing, and RFE/NOID defense. It also promises disclosure of any out-of-package costs before work begins, so the all-in cost is stated up front. However, these fees are bundled rather than separated: the evidence shows no itemized split between the firm's legal fees and USCIS or premium-processing charges, and the headline hedges that filing fees are included only "where stated." Missing for 10: an itemized breakdown of legal fees vs. USCIS filing and premium processing fees, actual price figures, and independent corroboration that the all-inclusive pricing holds in practice.
